take_homes: An AI can build me a small helper for something I do by hand every week, like the Monday delivery report, and I fix it by telling it what is wrong.
Having access to a tool is not the same as people using it. I know that from our own systems.
A person decides in the end, and you make the AI say which file it got things from.

one_line: The first half, where it built me a report, was useful. The second half was meetings between robots, and I would have left at four.
